intent: A small arrow hanging below an open trigger, pointing from it at the shared popup.
typical_uses: An optional marker under each expanding entry, visible only on the open one

instead.note: NavigationMenuTrigger already renders its NavigationMenuIcon chevron.

invariants.text: The indicator belongs to the NavigationMenuItem it is rendered in and throws outside one; each expanding item carries its own, and only the open item's indicator is visible (`data-popup-open`). It is positioned directly under its item, not moved along the list.
The indicator renders a fixed arrow as its only child; children passed to it are ignored. It is hidden from assistive technology.

render.states: render replaces the rendered element with one the caller supplies
render.because: Base UI's render prop takes an element or a function of the indicator's own state, so its type is a union of a React element and a callback - the compiler emits one JSON type per property.

style.states: style accepts a function of the indicator's state as well as a plain style object
style.because: Base UI widens React's `CSSProperties` to `CSSProperties | ((state) => CSSProperties)` so a caller can style off the primitive's own state (open). The compiler emits one JSON type per property, so nothing is asserted; the kit's own styling goes through navigation-menu.module.css, not through this.

unexposed_parts.reason: NavigationMenuIndicator renders one rotated square as its child to draw the arrow; the kit exports no part for it.

bad.title: One indicator for the whole list
bad.why: The indicator reads its item from the nearest NavigationMenuItem; outside one the primitive throws.
